evals.prompt: Implement a 2D physics projectile simulation in Python with decoupled Renderer and Input protocols for Raylib.
evals.expected_output: Core physics module with slots, a Protocol-based renderer interface, and a Raylib engine implementation importing pyray as pr.
assertions: Imports Raylib strictly as 'import pyray as pr'
Decouples simulation physics from rendering via typing.Protocol interfaces
Core update function is pure and accepts delta time (dt)
Raylib drawing functions are isolated inside the engine/renderer layer

evals.prompt: Write automated headless pytest unit tests for character collision and movement mechanics without initializing a Raylib window.
evals.expected_output: A pytest test suite using NullGraphics or mock renderers and stubbed inputs to verify game state transitions.
assertions: Executes headlessly in pytest without opening a graphical window (pr.init_window)
Uses mock/stub input implementations to test deterministic movement
Asserts state updates cleanly against expected coordinates
Tests can run in CI environments without a display server
